description: This file defines the 'ViewMultiedit' class, which handles the display logic for a multi-edit view in the SuiteCRM system. It extends the 'SugarView' class and manages AJAX form save actions, module processing, and dynamic JavaScript generation for multiple modules.

classes.name: ViewMultiedit
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and managing a multi-module edit view in the SuiteCRM interface, including AJAX handling and dynamic form rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the ViewMultiedit object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the multi-edit form, handles AJAX save requests, generates JavaScript for module forms, and displays module edit views.
